rows.title: Dispatch Loom
rows.subtitle: Dispatch reconciliation tool
rows.summary: A dispatch reconciliation tool for checking mismatched references by comparing the overnight spreadsheet against the daily export. Ada personally built its Python parser and SQL checks. Operators preferred a visible warning when the source file arrived late, and empty rows were kept visible. PostgreSQL was the production database and Git held the changes.

I used Git for version control and PostgreSQL for the production database. The dispatch desk dealt with mismatched references rather than delivery route optimization. Operators compared the overnight spreadsheet against the daily export. The source file could arrive late and the operators preferred a visible warning. I remember a meeting where we debated whether to hide empty rows. We kept them visible because a blank reference might need a phone call.
